question:
The minute hand of a watch is 1.5 cm long. How far does its tip move in 40 minutes?

(take π = 3.14)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The minute hand covers a full circle (distance of 2πr) in 60 minutes.

Distance covered in 40 minutes = (40 ÷ 60) × 2πr = (2 ÷ 3) × 2πr

⇒ Distance = (2 ÷ 3) × 2 × 3.14 × 1.5

⇒ Distance = 2 × 3.14 = 6.28 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6.28 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the minute hand (radius, r) = 1.5 cm

Time moved by minute hand = 40 minutes

Value of π ≈ 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Distance moved by the tip = Arc length = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

Angle swept by the minute hand in 1 minute = 360° ÷ 60 = 6°

**Calculations:**

⇒ Angle swept in 40 minutes (θ) = 40 × 6° = 240°

⇒ Distance moved = (240° ÷ 360°) × 2πr

⇒ Distance moved = (2 ÷ 3) × 2 × 3.14 × 1.5

⇒ Distance moved = (2 ÷ 3) × 3.14 × 3

⇒ Distance moved = 2 × 3.14

⇒ Distance moved = 6.28 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6.28 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Clock Hands

The minute hand sweeps 360° in 60 minutes, yielding a speed of 6° per minute. The hour hand sweeps 360° in 12 hours (720 minutes), giving a speed of 0.5° per minute.

Area of a Sector

If asked for the area swept by the clock hand over a specific time, use the sector area formula: Area = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr².

Arc Length in Radians

When the angle θ is given in radians instead of degrees, the arc length distance can be calculated directly using the simpler formula: s = rθ.
